description.sr:
Napiši funkciju `countdown(n)` koja vraća niz brojeva od `n` do 1, opadajuće.

Ako je `n` jednako 0 ili manje od 0, vraća prazan niz `[]`.

Primeri:
- `countdown(3)` → `[3, 2, 1]`
- `countdown(1)` → `[1]`
- `countdown(0)` → `[]`
- `countdown(-2)` → `[]`
description.en:
Write a function `countdown(n)` that returns an array of numbers from `n` down to 1, decreasing.

If `n` is 0 or less than 0, it returns an empty array `[]`.

Examples:
- `countdown(3)` → `[3, 2, 1]`
- `countdown(1)` → `[1]`
- `countdown(0)` → `[]`
- `countdown(-2)` → `[]`

text.sr:
Ovde pravimo (deklarišemo) funkciju. Funkcija je imenovan komad koda koji možemo da pozovemo koliko god puta hoćemo, svaki put sa drugim ulazom.

- `function countdown` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom. Test je poziva baš tim imenom, pa mora biti napisano tačno ovako (velika i mala slova se razlikuju).
- `(n)` je lista parametara. Parametar je prazno „mesto“ za ulaz: kad pozovemo `countdown(3)`, unutar funkcije je `n` jednako `3`.
- `{` otvara telo funkcije, a zatvara ga `}` u liniji 8.

Sama deklaracija ništa ne računa. Kod iz tela se izvršava tek kad funkciju pozovemo.
text.en:
Here we create (declare) a function. A function is a named piece of code that we can call as many times as we like, each time with different input.

- `function countdown` creates a function with that name. The test calls it by exactly this name, so it must be spelled exactly like this (letter case matters).
- `(n)` is the parameter list. A parameter is an empty “slot” for input: when we call `countdown(3)`, inside the function `n` equals `3`.
- `{` opens the function body, and `}` on line 8 closes it.

The declaration itself computes nothing. The code in the body runs only when we call the function.

text.sr:
Prazan niz u koji skupljamo brojeve.

- `const result = [];` pravi prazan niz; `[]` je prazan niz.
- `const` jer se promenljiva ne dodeljuje ponovo. Sadržaj niza se menja (dodajemo elemente), što je dozvoljeno.
- Ako se petlja ne izvrši nijednom (`n` je 0 ili manje), ovaj prazan niz se vraća, što test traži.
text.en:
An empty array in which we collect the numbers.

- `const result = [];` creates an empty array; `[]` is an empty array.
- `const` because the variable is not reassigned. The array's contents change (we add elements), which is allowed.
- If the loop does not run at all (`n` is 0 or less), this empty array is returned, which the test requires.

text.sr:
Petlja `while` ponavlja telo dok god je uslov tačan.

- `while (uslov) { ... }` proverava uslov PRE svakog prolaza. Kad postane `false`, petlja se završava.
- `n > 0` znači „`n` je veće od nule“. Zato se `0` ne upisuje u niz, a za `0` i negativne brojeve uslov je odmah netačan i telo se ne izvršava.
- Za razliku od `for`, ovde nema ugrađenog brojača: sama promenljiva `n` se menja u telu (linija 5).
- `{` otvara telo; zatvara ga `}` u liniji 6.
text.en:
The `while` loop repeats its body as long as the condition is true.

- `while (condition) { ... }` checks the condition BEFORE every pass. When it becomes `false`, the loop ends.
- `n > 0` means “`n` is greater than zero”. That is why `0` is not written into the array, and for `0` and negative numbers the condition is immediately false and the body does not run.
- Unlike `for`, there is no built-in counter here: the variable `n` itself changes in the body (line 5).
- `{` opens the body; it is closed by `}` on line 6.

text.sr:
Dodajemo trenutnu vrednost `n` na kraj niza.

- `result.push(n)` dodaje `n` na kraj niza `result`. Zato niz raste redom `3`, pa `2`, pa `1`: opadajuće, kako zadatak traži.
text.en:
We add the current value of `n` to the end of the array.

- `result.push(n)` adds `n` to the end of the array `result`. That is why the array grows in the order `3`, then `2`, then `1`: decreasing, as the task requires.

text.sr:
Smanjujemo `n` za 1, da bi petlja jednom stala.

- `n--` znači „oduzmi 1 od `n`“, tj. isto što i `n = n - 1`. Suprotno je od `n++`.
- Bez ove linije `n` se nikad ne bi menjalo, uslov `n > 0` bi uvek bio tačan i petlja bi radila u nedogled (beskonačna petlja).
- Menja se lokalna kopija parametra: brojevi se prosleđuju po vrednosti, pa promenljiva pozivaoca ostaje ista.

Tok za `countdown(3)`:

```
početak:   n = 3, result = []
prolaz 1:  3 > 0 tačno → push(3) → result = [3]       → n = 2
prolaz 2:  2 > 0 tačno → push(2) → result = [3, 2]    → n = 1
prolaz 3:  1 > 0 tačno → push(1) → result = [3, 2, 1] → n = 0
provera:   0 > 0 netačno → petlja se završava
```
text.en:
We decrease `n` by 1, so the loop eventually stops.

- `n--` means “subtract 1 from `n`”, i.e. the same as `n = n - 1`. It is the opposite of `n++`.
- Without this line `n` would never change, the condition `n > 0` would always be true and the loop would run forever (an infinite loop).
- A local copy of the parameter is changed: numbers are passed by value, so the caller's variable stays the same.

Flow for `countdown(3)`:

```
start:     n = 3, result = []
pass 1:    3 > 0 true → push(3) → result = [3]       → n = 2
pass 2:    2 > 0 true → push(2) → result = [3, 2]    → n = 1
pass 3:    1 > 0 true → push(1) → result = [3, 2, 1] → n = 0
check:     0 > 0 false → the loop ends
```

text.sr:
Zatvara telo petlje otvoreno u liniji 3.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the loop body opened on line 3.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

text.sr:
Vraća popunjen niz.

- `return result` šalje niz pozivaocu. Za `0` ili negativan `n` to je prazan niz `[]`.
text.en:
Returns the filled array.

- `return result` sends the array to the caller. For `0` or a negative `n` that is the empty array `[]`.

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: `while` je prirodan kad se broj ponavljanja ne zadaje unapred, nego zavisi od uslova.
note.en: `while` is natural when the number of repetitions is not given in advance but depends on a condition.
